tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Dori expressing desire, using only the supplied approved neutral as the reference for character identity, skin, hair, eyes, costume, colors, rendering and compact childlike proportions. Act the emotion with a genuinely different body pose: wholesome eager anticipation of a favorite treat or adventure, hopeful eyes, a small excited smile, leaning forward slightly with hands apart near her chest. Keep the acting age-appropriate and non-suggestive. Normal pupils. Simple readable natural hands near the torso, coherent anatomy with one thumb and four fingers per hand where visible, exactly two legs and feet in an uncomplicated stance. Keep the entire silhouette including hair, accessories, hands and shoes in frame, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding. Transparent background, no scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects or baked shadow.
